positions.as_written: Use sequences that separate cartilage from fluid, since the unossified epiphysis is cartilage and an effusion is not.
Compare with the other knee where the question is whether an appearance is normal, since development is broadly symmetrical.
Keep the study short, because movement degrades a child's images more often than anything else does.
